## 3. Flagship Projects Breakdown

### A. Zewar Desk — Multi-Tenant Jewellery ERP
- Type: Production Product / Architecture
- Technologies: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, React Query, Playwright
- Code Repository: https://github.com/rajakrp18
- Architecture Highlights:
  - Architected a production multi-tenant ERP platform across 4 core business domains: inventory lifecycle, automated billing, customer CRM, and reporting.
  - Implemented 18+ modular REST APIs with per-company and per-fiscal-year database isolation.
  - Built JWT HTTP-only cookie authentication and RBAC middleware enforcing strict authorization across admin, staff, and billing tiers.
  - Constructed 50+ frontend views with React Query and Zustand for client cache synchronization and automated end-to-end QA flows using Playwright.

### B. Cyber Law Watch Agent (LexSentry)
- Type: Applied AI & Regulatory Intelligence Platform
- Technologies: FastAPI, Next.js 14, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (Async), Google Gemini API, Docker, aiosqlite, LangGraph
- Code Repository: https://github.com/rajakrp18/cyberlaw-watchdog
- Architecture Highlights:
  - Ingests and priority-scores (P0-P2) precedents across 8 authoritative constitutional courts and regulatory bodies (Supreme Court of India, High Courts of Delhi, Karnataka, Bombay, Telangana, Reserve Bank of India, CERT-In, I4C/NCRP 1930).
  - Built a multi-turn Legal RAG Copilot with source-grounded certified PDF citations and a local statutory ratio fallback engine for zero-downtime offline resilience.
  - Engineered in-app API key diagnostics panel with live roundtrip ping testing and in-memory hot-reloading without server restarts.
  - Generated T-63 associate litigation tasks and court-ready petition clauses under Section 457 Cr.P.C. / Section 503 BNSS.

### C. Contact Finder & Project Researcher Monorepo
- Type: Multi-Agent AI Monorepo
- Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Transformers.js, Google Gemini API, Puppeteer, SQLite, Vercel
- Live URL: https://project-researcher-contact-finder.vercel.app
- Code Repository: https://github.com/rajakrp18/Project-Researcher
- Architecture Highlights:
  - Dual-app monorepo combining an Indian OSINT contact-attribution engine and an automated software architecture PRD generator.
  - Engineered a 4-agent investigation pipeline (Coordinator, Researcher, Extractor, Verifier) with a weighted 0-100% identity confidence scoring model.
  - Combined regex parsing, offline semantic chunking (Transformers.js), and Gemini Flash / Vision OCR for obfuscated canvas records.
  - Supported bulk CSV and AI PDF-to-CSV dividend statement ingestion with exponential backoff rate limiting, OpenRouter fallback, and BYOK client-side key management.
